title: Project and Program Management
lead: Structured approaches to planning, executing and governing projects and programmes — ensuring delivery on time, budget and scope.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Project and Program Management (PPM) provides the governance, methods and tools to deliver complex change initiatives. It covers the full lifecycle from business case through to benefits realisation. PPM methodologies range from traditional (PRINCE2, MSP, PMI) to agile (SAFe, Scrum at Scale) depending on the nature of the change.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: PPM is both an enabler and a service in ITOM. As an enabler, it governs the journey from current to target operating model. As a service, it is often part of the target operating model — managing IT-enabled business change on behalf of the organisation. ITOM designs define the PPM governance model, roles and tooling.

items.desc: Steering structures, decision rights and risk management across a programme.
The justification for investment including costs, benefits and risks.
Applying agile principles at programme level — SAFe, LeSS, MSP Agile.
Tracking and confirming that expected benefits are delivered post-implementation.
Prioritisation and governance of the programme and project portfolio.
